description_for_human: Live brand creative guidelines and production rules for ecommerce creative generation.
description_for_model: Creative DNA connects ChatGPT to a live, structured brand knowledge system containing creative direction, visual rules, landing-page systems, asset specifications, product-image rules, UGC direction, and brand-specific production constraints. Strictly read-only connection to the Creative DNA canonical datastore. Use list_creative_dna_routes to discover available brand routes, and resolve_creative_dna to resolve canonical specifications.
